notes:
Orrery 0.15.3

Dueling
- Taking control works online. Drag one of your opponent's cards onto your field, or drag a card out of their GY or banishment onto your field, and it moves on both screens. You can also hand one of your cards to them by dragging it onto their side.
- Taken cards still belong to their owner; when one leaves the field it goes to its owner's GY, banishment, hand or Deck.
- Spectate a duel with a Watch Code from the Lobby.
- Spell/Trap cards can hold counters.
- Reveal Hand shows your opponent your hand, fanned out.
- When you target one of your opponent's cards, they see it on their screen.
- Shuffle your face-down Spells/Traps from their right-click menu or with /shufflebackrow; the cards slide around on both screens.
- Solo duels: Choose Hand lets you pick your opening hand for testing, and can keep it for every test duel with that deck.
- Your alt art shows in duels, and your opponent sees it too.
- Cards with their own drawn effect play it when summoned or played, not only when activated.
- Save Replay is on the results screen.
- Clicking the fanned-out Deck again closes it and shuffles.
- Press Z in Card Lookup to zoom in on a card.
- More animation: cards turn when switching ATK/DEF, menu moves fly to the hand or Deck, Field Spell backgrounds fade between each other, your opponent's Deck riffles when they shuffle, and a few more.
- The turn timer only speeds up while it's counting down.

Fixes
- A face-down card's shine no longer stays behind after the card leaves the field.
- Face-down sleeves are sized like a card instead of being cropped.
- The opponent's Field Spell stack count is right after they reorder it.
- Trade requests sent by both players at once no longer get stuck.
- Daily and Trick-or-Treat packs give their Tokens, and a pulled card that makes a Token gives you that Token. Tokens you missed from packs you already opened are added when you start the app.

Elsewhere
- Deck Lab's Hand Simulator has a Best & Worst Hands tab, scored by your deck's tags.
- Settings has a search box that jumps to the option you're looking for.
- Bulk Sell and Bulk Buy show card art and a preview.
- Pulled cards in the pack opener show the card info on hover, and flip over in 3D.
